$comment: Every export of @akshayanimateddsa/lab-player, one line each (test/catalogue.test.js checks this list against the code). The views a lab draws come from @akshayanimateddsa/visual-lab; this package plays them.

player.createVisualizer: Mounts the whole player in an element: header, panels of views, operation pop-up, legend, step note, code and variables, controls, shortcuts, fullscreen modes.
player.createTrace: Records an algorithm run as snapshot frames: each step deep-copies its state; panel state carries over and is replaced, never merged.
player.createPlayer: Playback over a fixed frame list (play, pause, step, seek, speed); emits frame and state events; big jumps are instant.

parts.createControls: The playback bar: reset, previous, play, next, end, scrubber, step counter, speed, and tool buttons at the end.
parts.createCodePanel: Java source with the step's line(s) highlighted, red / green marked lines, a copy button and a text-size dropdown.
parts.createVarsPanel: The variables in scope, marking the ones changed since the previous frame.
parts.highlightJava: One line of Java as HTML with tok-* spans (comments, strings, numbers, keywords, types, calls).
parts.createLegend: A ul.vz-legend: one tone swatch and label per item.
parts.CalloutView: A view: a highlighted message block in the stage (title, text, tone) that flashes when it changes; optional placeholder.

settings.THEMES: The nine colour themes (Dark: Midnight, Graphite, Deep ocean; Neon: Cyberpunk, Synthwave, Galaxy, Spotlight; Bright: Paper, Pastel).
settings.createThemePicker: The theme dropdown: applies a theme to every visualizer on the page and remembers it.
settings.currentMotion: The motion profile in use (Smooth until the page allows the choice).
settings.setMotion: Chooses the motion for every visualizer on the page and remembers it.
settings.motionAllowed: Whether the viewer may choose the motion on this page.
settings.setMotionAllowed: Turns the motion choice on (the saved motion) or off (Smooth).
settings.onMotionChange: Runs a function whenever the motion, or whether it may be chosen, changes.
settings.createMotionPicker: The Motion dropdown for a control bar; hidden while the choice is off.
settings.mountMotionSetting: A labelled Motion dropdown placed in a page element; hidden while the choice is off.

css.css/player.css: The player box (.vz-*): layout, controls, code and variables panels, legend, step note, operation pop-up, callout (.co), shortcuts list, fullscreen and recording-frame modes, phone layout, syntax colours.
css.css/themes.css: The nine themes: .vz holds Midnight's box tokens, each .vz[data-theme] block overrides the colours (palette, syntax, box, views).
